title: THE CO-OP SCORE SCREEN
why: His pick from the feature list. When a player raid ends in a party, his window sends the party his score: how it ended, kills, what he carried out and its worth, downs and revives. Every end card now shows a PARTY block with one row per player, reading still up top for a teammate who is still in the raid until his score comes.
now: THE CO-OP SCORE SCREEN, his pick from the feature list. A party raid that ends sends the party a score word (how it ended, kills, what was carried out and its worth, downs, revives), and every end card shows a PARTY block, one row per player; a teammate still up top reads so until his score arrives, then his row fills in.
